## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A later escalation matching an existing policy's trigger is auto-resolved...

The system SHALL ensure that a later escalation matching an existing policy's trigger is auto-resolved with a citation to the policy ID, and the auto-resolution is audited.

#### Scenario: A later escalation matching an existing policy's trigger is auto-resolved...

WHEN `auto-apply-matching-playbook-policies-at-escalation-time` is implemented
THEN A later escalation matching an existing policy's trigger is auto-resolved with a citation to the policy ID, and the auto-resolution is audited.

### Requirement: An unmatched escalation presents at least two options with tradeoffs, not a...

The system SHALL ensure that an unmatched escalation presents at least two options with tradeoffs, not a single recommendation.

#### Scenario: An unmatched escalation presents at least two options with tradeoffs, not a...

WHEN `auto-apply-matching-playbook-policies-at-escalation-time` is implemented
THEN An unmatched escalation presents at least two options with tradeoffs, not a single recommendation.
